results.author: September 05, 2018
results.text:
Kerusso Haul Skip to main content

One of the best parts about being a blogger is getting introduced to new brands. I don’t mean in the sense that we get free products, but more in the sense of learning about a brand that I might not have otherwise heard of. Kerusso is a perfect example of that. I had the opportunity to learn about their brand for the first time and order some of their products to try. Kerusso is a Christian based clothing company with products ranging anywhere from hats and shirts to even a few jewelry pieces.

As of right now, I believe the only place to buy their products is on their website. Thankfully they shipped my order pretty quickly and it arrived within a few days. Slow shipment times drive me crazy, so I was happy to have my order as fast as I did. Their shipping rates vary based on the order. There is a free shipping minimum, though they don’t state what it is and you can’t see it until you get to checkout. That’s one aspect of their site I think they could improve on.

The first shirt I chose is their Thankful Grateful Blessed T-Shirt. T-Shirts like these are some of my favorite to wear. They’re so comfortable and can match with any kind of jeans or shorts. I love the color combination that they chose. The fake pocket on the front actually adds a lot more to the shirt than you would probably think. I got this in an adult size small, along with everything else I ordered, and it fits me perfectly.

I’ve always loved the design of feathers, so obviously I needed this Feathers Missy T-Shirt in my life. It’s a little bit more form fitting than the previous shirt, but it still has the same t-shirt feel to it. I like that this design one has more of a style to it than some of the others. They also have a lot of silly pun shirts on their site that were actually pretty cute.

I loved the way this shirt matches with their Flower Feather Earrings. I specifically intended on matching the two of these together, but these earrings actually pair perfectly with every piece that I got. They’re super lightweight and can jazz up a messy bun in seconds.

Can you tell gray is one of my favorite colors to wear? I love basic shades that match with everything. Raglan style shirts are also a new favorite of mine, although I honestly didn’t even know what they were called until I saw this Live Fearless shirt. I think this style is so flattering and perfect for someone like me, who is always cold. The ¾ sleeves add just enough without making it too hot and heavy feeling. This is one that is going to get a ton of wear this Fall season!

The last piece that I got really speaks about me as a person and my interests. My heart has always had a weakness for the soldiers that fight for our freedom, so much so that I’ve even cried in public at a Veteran’s Day parade before. That’s just one topic that is always guaranteed to bring me to tears.

Kerusso vs Elevated Faith | Which Christian Clothing Brand Wins? - All Christian Blog

Christian apparel has moved beyond simple church T-shirts. Today, it is a global movement where believers proudly wear their faith on their sleeves—literally. Two names dominate the conversation in 2025: Kerusso and Elevated Faith.

Both brands have loyal followers, massive reach, and very different approaches to spreading the Gospel through clothing. But which one truly stands out? In this detailed review and comparison, we’ll look at their history, products, style, pricing, reputation, and influence—so you can decide which brand fits your faith and lifestyle best.

## Kerusso Review: Is It Worth Buying in 2025?

### Q: What is Kerusso known for?

Kerusso, founded in 1987, is one of the oldest and largest Christian clothing brands in the world. It is known for bold, evangelistic T-shirts that carry strong Biblical messages. With over 100 million products sold, Kerusso has become almost synonymous with Christian apparel.

### Quick Facts about Kerusso

- Founded: 1987
- Founder: Vic Kennett
- Headquarters: Berryville, Arkansas, USA
- Reach: Global (sold in 100+ countries)
- Main Products: T-shirts, jewelry, gifts, drinkware, accessories
- Audience: Broad—families, churches, ministries, mission groups

### Strengths of Kerusso

1. Heritage & Trust – With nearly four decades in business, Kerusso is considered the pioneer of Christian fashion.

2. Affordability – Most T-shirts range between $15–$30, making them accessible to families and bulk orders for ministries.

3. Wide Distribution – Available in Christian bookstores, church conferences, and global markets—not just online.

4. Evangelistic Design – Their slogans and designs are often conversation starters for sharing the Gospel.

### Weaknesses of Kerusso

1. Conservative Style – While bold, their designs often feel traditional, which may not attract Gen Z or fashion-forward believers.

2. Limited Trend Appeal – Compared to modern streetwear-inspired brands, Kerusso sometimes lacks the “cool factor.”

3. Heavy Competition – With new faith-based brands emerging, Kerusso’s traditional approach risks being overshadowed.

### Verdict on Kerusso:

Kerusso is perfect if you want affordable, traditional Christian apparel with a strong evangelistic edge. It appeals most to families, churches, and believers who prioritize message over fashion trends.

---

## Elevated Faith Review: Is It Worth Buying in 2025?

### Q: Why is Elevated Faith so popular?

Elevated Faith, launched in 2015, is the modern face of Christian fashion. Known for its minimalist designs, jewelry, and trendy clothing, it resonates deeply with Millennials and Gen Z.

### Quick Facts about Elevated Faith

- Founded: 2015
- Founder: Josh Gander
- Headquarters: Scottsdale, Arizona, USA
- Reach: 100+ countries (strong online presence)
- Main Products: T-shirts, hoodies, rings, bracelets, stickers, accessories

For many believers, what they wear is also a reflection of their values, faith, and the message they want to carry into everyday spaces. Clothing can speak before words ever do, making it a powerful tool for encouragement, testimony, and connection with people from all walks of life.

Christian apparel has grown steadily in popularity as people look for creative and approachable ways to express their beliefs beyond church walls. Instead of limiting faith expression to Sundays or special events, graphic T-shirts allow individuals to live out their testimony in grocery stores, classrooms, offices, gyms, coffee shops, and social gatherings. A simple phrase, verse, or symbol can open the door to meaningful conversations that may otherwise never happen, creating opportunities to share hope in natural and loving ways.

Kerusso is a well-known Christian apparel brand built on the idea that faith should be proclaimed boldly yet naturally in everyday life. Their designs blend scripture-inspired messages, modern typography, artistic graphics, and high-quality materials to create clothing that feels contemporary while remaining deeply rooted in biblical truth. Whether worn to church, school, work, outreach events, travel days, or casual outings, Kerusso T-shirts help believers share hope in ways that feel authentic rather than forced.

Each shirt carries its own personality while pointing back to timeless spiritual truths that encourage both the wearer and those around them.

The phrase encourages believers to replace worry with trust and conversation with God, reflecting biblical teachings about casting anxieties on Him and experiencing peace beyond understanding. I have a few friends that are extremely hard to shop for. I know they have a very close connection to God… and I always wanted to find something that would fit their lifestyle. And I think I have just found the perfect Company: Kerusso. Kerusso has a little bit for everyone – from Mens and Womens apparel to Kids apparel to accessories such as guitar pics and Drumsticks.

A few facts about Kerusso: 1. Kerusso is the Greek word for “preach”. 2. Mission: Proclaiming the Good News to the world through products about Jesus. 3. Kerusso’s Tagline: “Change your shirt. Change the world!”

Growing up one of my favorite Church hymns was Eagles Wings. It holds a special place in my heart for many reasons…. so when I saw that Kerusso had a beautiful Hoody that had the words Eagles Wings on it… I knew it was meant to be mine. I was not sure how their hoodies ran, so I requested an XL. Sometimes women’s hoodies run small – because they are cut so Hour Glass Shaped. The cut of these are much less hour glass shaped – so it is a little big on me – but I love it still. I usually wear baggier hoodies around the house – they always seem warmer and more comfortable. This is a light weight hoodie though. So it is perfect for the spring and fall weather. There is a bible scripture quote on the front of the shirt – it reads “but those who hope in the LORD will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.” Isaiah 40:31

Every year I struggle around the holiday season to come up with the perfect Christian gifts for my mother and my mother-in-law. Both women are hard to buy for but when it comes to any item that they can express their faith…well, that’s always a winner!

Recently I was introduced to Kerusso which is an online Christian gift store. They sell travel tumblers, Christian t-shirts, key chains, flashlights, tank-tops, hoodies, Christian jewelry and more! They also have Breast Cancer Awareness and graduation gifts too!

For this review I selected 2 items to feature for all of you. I am putting together a gift bag full of gifts for my mother this holiday season and both of these items will be in the bag.

The “ Trust in the Lord Christian Travel Tumbler” is the perfect gift for someone who is always on-the-go like my mother! It’s a double-walled insulated tumbler so you can use it with hot or cold beverages. It has an easy-to-operate screw-on cap with a locking mechanism to prevent spillage. It’s a tall & slender travel tumbler so it should fit within most auto cup holders.

The design is inside the travel tumbler between the two insulating walls. One side says “Trust in the Lord:” and the other side says “With All Your Heart Proverbs 3:5”. I love that it expresses your faith and gives you inspiration too!

The second item that I selected to feature is the “ God is Good Owl Flashlight” which is absolutely adorable! My mom and I share a love for owls so it was really hard to NOT keep this one for myself. The design is of an owl and it says “God is Good Owl the Time” and refers to Psalm 100:5.

The flashlight is a miniature one that is perfect for mom to keep in her purse or in the glove box of her car. It has a bright LED light, a carrying strap and operates with a simple push button. Oh yeah…batteries are included so you don’t need to buy those! Everyone needs a good little LED flashlight in their purse, briefcase, tool box, household drawer and/or glove box!

I think both of these Christian gift items are just perfect for my mother this holiday season and I know she is going to love them! In the gift bag that I’m making up…I’m going to include a bag of her favorite coffee, a box of her favorite hot cocoa, the travel tumbler and flashlight from this review and a gift card. I love putting together gift packages just like this for my family and friends!

Head on over to Kerusso and check out all of the lovely Christian gifts that they have to offer.
